title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: No outright mathematical error on this page; it is a programmatic summary.

The claim (finished on p. 51) that among the realizations F ⊂ P(M) there is a largest one, namely all ≤-closed pairwise-compatible subsets, is asserted without checking that this family satisfies the chiffon axioms (interpolation, disjunction, At C). It is only obviously maximal among families of such subsets.
The surrounding pages (p. 49) show the axiom set is not yet stable: lemmas needed for MA4/MA5 could not be proved, so the 'simpler' Prat system is still conjectural at this stage.

ideas.what: Axiomatizing tame/stratified topology by an order structure (F, ≤, ≪): an inclusion order plus a 'strongly contained / in the shadow of' relation, with interpolation and disjunction axioms.
ideas.modern_name: Proximity / strong-inclusion lattices (de Vries algebras, Smyth–Vickers 'way-below'-type relations), pointfree topology; tame topology / o-minimal structures
ideas.usually_credited_to: de Vries (1962) for compingent algebras; Johnstone and Vickers for pointfree approaches; van den Dries and others for o-minimality
ideas.where_published: Only a programmatic call for tame topology appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), §5-6; the chiffon axiomatics are unpublished.

ideas.what: Replacing the family of objects by an 'algebra of (multi)strata' (M, ≤, ≪, ≬), with a reflexive symmetric compatibility relation inherited downward, and recovering spaces as ≤-closed, pairwise compatible subsets of M.
ideas.modern_name: Coherence spaces / prime event structures (configurations = down-closed conflict-free subsets); Scott information systems; posets of strata of stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: Nielsen–Plotkin–Winskel (1981) event structures; Girard (1987) coherence spaces; Scott (1982) information systems

ideas.what: Relative notions 'A-spacious' and 'A-polyhedral' objects with respect to a given subset A ⊂ M, and axioms At C(spac) / At C(pol).
ideas.modern_name: No standard name; analogous to relative tameness / definability with respect to a subcollection

ideas.what: One combinatorial structure has several realizations as set-families, with a largest canonical one.
ideas.modern_name: Free / maximal completion (ideal completion, configuration domain)

missed.claim: The 'pré-chiffon' (M, ≤, ≬) has a partial order and a reflexive symmetric compatibility that is inherited by smaller elements (p. 51). Its largest realization, all ≤-closed pairwise compatible subsets, is exactly the configuration domain of a prime event structure: compatibility is the complement of conflict, and conflict is inherited upward. It is also the clique space of a coherence space with an order. So in 1986 Grothendieck was independently arriving at the event-structure / coherence-space formalism of concurrency theory and linear logic, but as a foundation for tame topology of stratified spaces. The literature does not seem to link stratified-space combinatorics with event structures and domain theory in this way.
missed.quote: Il y a lieu de considérer (M, ≤, ≪, ≭) comme une structure algébrique indépendante, on pourrait l'appeler une "pré-chiffon" (ou "algèbre de multistrates"...). Elle peut correspondre à plusieurs chiffons (réalisés comme des F ⊂ P(M))
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This suggests importing domain-theoretic tools (stable domains, dI-domains, event-structure morphisms) into the combinatorics of stratifications and exit-path posets. Conversely, it suggests a topological reading of concurrency models, where directed topology already exists.

missed.claim: The programme of an independent 'algebra of strata' axiomatics for tame spaces, with spacious and polyhedral variants At C(spac) / At C(pol), was left unfinished. P. 49 records failed lemmas and the need for a stronger axiom. No later work develops Grothendieck's chiffon or pré-chiffon axiomatics.
missed.quote: mais le syst. d'axiomes pertinent semble plus simple
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: An order-theoretic axiomatization of tame topology, alternative to o-minimality, remains a stated goal of the Esquisse that nobody has realized in this form.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a recap page, but it records the explicit proposal to make an 'algebra of strata' with compatibility relation an independent structure, realized canonically by down-closed compatible subsets. That structure coincides with event structures / coherence spaces, which is an unremarked connection. Mathematically the page itself is light and programmatic.
transcription_corrections: 'Ax C (spac) resp. Ax C (pol)' should read 'At C (spac) resp. At C (pol)', consistent with the 'At 1 à At 7' notation on p. 51.
The relation in '(M, ≤, ≪, ≭)' is written with the same compatibility symbol (≬-like) used on p. 51, not a 'not-asymp' symbol.
'pré-...' is likely 'pré-chiffon' (cf. 'provenant d'un chiffon' on p. 49).
'Elle peut correspondre à plusieurs objets[?]' is likely 'plusieurs chiffons' (continued on p. 51 as 'parmi lesquelles/lesquels ... la plus grande').
'axiomes d'interpolation[?] — disjonction' is uncertain; it may read 'd'incompatibilité–disjonction'.
'les données sont peu plus compliquées' should read 'les données sont un peu plus compliquées'.
'qui introduit[?] très directement[?] une notion d'objet[?] A-spacieux' plausibly reads 'qui intervient très directement dans les notions d'objets A-spacieux et A-polyédraux'.
